user.title: Heating Curve Optimizer
user.description: Shared settings. Add heating zones, PV arrays and a gas boiler afterwards from the integration page.

prices.name: Electricity prices
prices.description: Sensors with the price forecast the optimizer plans against.

data_description.consumption_price_sensor: Price per kWh with a forecast attribute (raw_today/raw_tomorrow, forecast_prices, net_prices_today/tomorrow, ...). The planning steps follow this sensor's interval (15 or 60 min).
data_description.production_price_sensor: Optional. Values heating on your own PV surplus at the feed-in price. Without it, 0.07 EUR/kWh is used.

sensors.name: Measurement sensors (optional)
sensors.description: Improve accuracy and enable thermal calibration and real-time PV-surplus control.

data_description.power_consumption: Power sensor (W or kW) of the heat pump. Enables thermal power/energy sensors and thermal calibration.
data_description.supply_temperature_sensor: Used for the COP of the measured operating point; otherwise the planned supply temperature is used.
data_description.grid_import_sensor: Live power (W or kW). With import and/or export configured, the real-time offset sensor raises the offset while PV surplus is exported.
data_description.grid_export_sensor: Live power (W or kW), positive while exporting.

heat_pump.name: Heat pump
heat_pump.description: COP = (base COP + outdoor coefficient x T_outdoor - k-factor x (T_supply - 35)) x compensation, capped at the Carnot limit and corrected for defrost losses.

data_description.base_cop: From the datasheet (e.g. A2/W35). Typical 3.5-4.5 for air-to-water.
data_description.k_factor: Typically 0.08-0.12: how fast COP drops with higher supply temperature.
data_description.cop_compensation_factor: Scales the modelled COP to your measured COP (1.0 = datasheet).
data_description.heat_pump_max_thermal_power_kw: Optional. Rated heating capacity. Empty: 1.3x the heat loss at the design outdoor temperature.

heating_curve.name: Heating curve
heating_curve.description: The heating curve as set on the heat pump. The optimizer plans an offset of -4 to +4 °C on top of it.

data.heat_curve_min: Supply temperature at the warm end
data.heat_curve_max: Supply temperature at the cold end
data.heat_curve_max_outdoor: Outdoor temperature of the warm end

data_description.heat_curve_min: Supply temperature at and above the warm-end outdoor temperature.
data_description.heat_curve_max: Supply temperature at and below the design outdoor temperature. The emitters are assumed to be sized for this point.

data_description.planning_window: Hours ahead to plan, limited by the available price forecast. Longer horizons shift more load.

detected_integrations.title: Detected companion integrations

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach open-meteo.com. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant.
error.price_sensor_required: A consumption price sensor is required.
error.curve_supply_range: The supply temperature at the warm end must be lower than at the cold end.
error.curve_outdoor_range: The design outdoor temperature must be lower than the warm-end outdoor temperature.

abort.already_configured: Heating Curve Optimizer is already configured.

data_description.indoor_temp_hysteresis_lower: The optimizer keeps the indoor temperature between target - lower and target + upper.
data_description.indoor_temperature_sensor: Strongly recommended. Without it the optimizer assumes the room is at the target temperature and calibration is not possible.
data_description.heat_curve_min: Only for a separate heating circuit with its own curve; leave both empty to use the main curve.

user.title: Hybrid gas boiler
user.description: Compares the heat pump's cost per kWh of heat with the gas boiler's.

data_description.gas_boiler_efficiency: 0.90 for a typical HR boiler; up to ~1.07 on upper heating value at low return temperatures.
data_description.gas_calorific_value_kwh_per_m3: Dutch G-gas upper heating value: 9.77 kWh/m³.
data_description.gas_comfort_backup: On: recommend the gas boiler whenever the heat pump cannot restore the comfort band within 3 hours, even if gas is more expensive. Off: only when gas is also cheaper.

indoor_sensor_unavailable.description: The indoor temperature sensor **{sensor}** is unavailable. Until it reports again, the optimizer assumes the room is at its target temperature and calibration is paused.

gas_price_sensor_unavailable.description: The gas price sensor **{sensor}** is unavailable. The gas boiler comparison cannot run without it.
